# ui::testing::StartupMilestones

Header: `winui/testing/PerfCounters.hpp`.

How long the process took to reach each point on the way to its first frame, counted from process creation. Unset for a point not reached yet, and on a platform the library has no backend for.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `first_window` | `std::optional<Duration>` |  | The first native window was created. |
| `first_frame` | `std::optional<Duration>` |  | The first frame was presented. |
| `first_idle` | `std::optional<Duration>` |  | The message loop ran out of messages for the first time: the app is up and waiting. |
